question: Who wins the Alaska Senate race in 2026
quote: I think right now, Peltola is going to hold on into this race and win.
turn_text: In Alaska, yes, it's another big red state where people are dependent on low energy prices. You know, maybe a month from now, it would be different. I think right now, Peltola is going to hold on into this race and win. You know, she has kind of established herself right from the start of this race as not like a prim class president type of candidate. You know, she almost seemed to me like her campaign leaked her private correspondence showing her, you know, using colorful language, like calling someone a retard. And I just think that that kind of spirit protects her in an environment like this where people want to elect someone who doesn't seem like they've been assimilated into the Borg of what a politician is.
host_quote: But Jim Garrity, we have a nip and tuck race in Alaska where there's some last-minute drama. Who's going to win?
resolution_criteria: The candidate who wins the 2026 Alaska US Senate general election, after ranked-choice tabulation if no candidate has a first-round majority. Decided by the Associated Press's call. If AP has not called it within 60 days of election day, the certified official result decides. Resolves when the race is called.
